## What changed

Describe the problem and the focused change that addresses it.

## User-visible impact

Describe behavior, compatibility, or visual differences. Include before/after screenshots for UI changes.

## Validation

List the exact commands, platforms, and viewports you checked. Clearly state anything you could not validate.

## Checklist

- [ ] The pull request has one coherent purpose and links related issues.
- [ ] I ran formatting, analysis, and relevant tests.
- [ ] I updated compatibility or maintenance documentation when needed.
- [ ] I did not commit build output, editor metadata, secrets, or personal data.
- [ ] New assets include their source and compatible reuse terms.
- [ ] Legacy migrations update SDK constraints, dependencies, deprecated APIs, tests, and platform scaffolding together.
